_note: Draft Actium world for the campaign skeleton. Flavor palette, not canon — overwrite freely. Registers: human holds use plain/weathered names; Halcyon Reach (elf) uses the Japanese register; Free Signal leans radio-aesthetic. Norodael is the mostly-abandoned frontier region and the player's start. Only ONE party roams (the rival); factions below just own settlements statically at start.

factions.name: Windward Compact
factions.flavor: Human mercantile polity; a radio-trade network strung between the leeward isles.

factions.name: Halcyon Reach
factions.flavor: Elf domain of the high quiet isles; old, coherent, unhurried.

factions.name: Free Signal
factions.flavor: Independent stations and drifter holds; loyal to a frequency, not a flag.

nodes.name: Norodael Landing
nodes.flavor: A half-abandoned mooring town on the Norodael frontier. Where nobodies begin.

nodes.name: Greywater
nodes.flavor: Salt-stained radio shacks around a dead relay tower.

nodes.name: The Last Mast
nodes.flavor: The furthest hold before the open air. Barely holding on.

nodes.name: Coldharbor
nodes.flavor: Windward's frontier customs station and staging yard.

nodes.name: Marrow Station
nodes.flavor: A trade hub of gantries and cargo cranes.

nodes.name: Aoi Spire
nodes.flavor: A pale tower-hold in the high quiet; old as the isles.

nodes.name: Kaede Hold
nodes.flavor: Terraced and unhurried; the Reach's leeward gate.

nodes.name: Static
nodes.flavor: A drifter station broadcasting a number that never changes.

nodes.name: Longwave
nodes.flavor: A hold that trades in frequencies and favors.

nodes.name: The Crossing
nodes.flavor: Where the frontier lanes braid together.

nodes.name: Open Air
nodes.flavor: A junction over nothing at all.
